characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If your army includes a MARNEUS CALGAR unit, you get to call each Doctrine twice, rather than just once. This lets you be in a Doctrine every turn of the game.

TARGET: One of your units under attack
EFFECT: Attacks that one enemy unit makes against one of your units have one less point of AP.

TARGET: An unengaged INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit
EFFECT: The unit gets to make a move of d3+3".
